expectations: A memory states the decision to raise the webhook delivery timeout to 20 seconds.
A memory states that every timed-out delivery is logged to the kestrel-webhook-audit stream.

items.memory: Kestrel webhook deliveries time out after 5 seconds, while receivers behind the acme gateway need up to 15 seconds.
The decision is to raise the webhook delivery timeout to 20 seconds.
A timed-out delivery is retried at most 3 times (`webhook.max_redeliveries`).
Every timed-out delivery is logged to the `kestrel-webhook-audit` stream, so support can answer tenants without reading the worker logs.
